Name: EBAGI - Fancy Artisan Goods Icons for Cornucopia - More Crops
Author: ShilohAreles
Description:
[left][center][color=#fff2cc][size=3][b]THIS MOD IS FOR STARDEW VERSION 1.6.[/b][/size][/color][/center]

This is an add on pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114018673]Aimon111[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23373]EBAGI - Fancy Artisan Goods Icons EBAGI Pack[/url], to match their sprites for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url].[b] This mod [i]will[/i] require [url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods[/url]﻿, the unofficial update to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2080]BAGI[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia - More Crops[/url]﻿ to function.

[/b][i][size=1]Please note that mead textures are not supported by EBAGI for the time being, and as such are not included with this mod at this time.

[/size][/i]Please consider [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28517/]EBAGI - Fancy Artisan Goods Icons for Cornucopia: More Flowers[/url]﻿, if you have the parent mod installed and want more fanci-fied honey varieties!

[font=Georgia][b][color=#ead1dc]Installation (stand alone)[/color]
[/b][/font][list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
[*]Install [b][url=https://github.com/chsiao58/EvenBetterArtisanGoodIcons/releases]Even Better Artisan Goods[/url][/b] from github and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]CMC[/url]﻿, [b][u]this is mandatory.[/u][/b]
[*]Unzip the file [BAGI] Fancy AGI for Cornucopia - More Crops into your mods folder.
[/list]
﻿[size=1]This mod can safely be uninstalled mid game without issue. Just delete the file from your Mods folder.
[/size]
If you already have Aimon111's parent mod pack, you could also unzip these files there for convenience.

[center][color=#fff2cc]Big thanks to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/114018673]Aimon111[/url] for their permission to pursue this add on. Credit to PlepArts for both color references and the use of their dried mushroom sprites for CMC.[/color][/center][/left]
